description: Native aligned allocation: normalize alignment, check request overflow, split and release leading/trailing chunks, and adjust mapped-chunk headers when indicated.

function_descriptions.sol35d7_aligned_allocate_80213a8c_v2: Native aligned allocation: normalize alignment, check request overflow, split and release leading/trailing chunks, and adjust mapped-chunk headers when indicated.

descriptions.sol35d7_aligned_allocate_80213a8c_v2: Allocates an aligned GC32 heap payload with native power-of-two normalization, errno12 rejection, mapped-header adjustment and leading/trailing chunk release. External allocator/header lifetime and unsigned-wrap contracts remain required; exact original library version and portable behavior are unproved.
